milestone: SeLinOS root-only modern virtio-blk BAR validation and feature observation M2

profile.qemu: QEMU 8.2.2 TCG instruction-count mode with virtio-blk-pci,disable-legacy=on

required_markers: SeLinOS storage M2: root-only uncached common-config feature observation passed; authority withheld.
SeLinOS storage M2: no BAR cap delegation, feature acceptance, status write, queue, IRQ, DMA or block I/O.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS storage M2: quarantined virtio BAR/feature observation failed; authority withheld.

validated_contract.pci_bar: Root probes an already assigned 32-bit or 64-bit memory BAR with memory decoding and bus mastering quiesced; it restores every BAR word and command bits before accepting scalar bounds.
validated_contract.mmio: Root allocates exactly one validated physical page, reserves and maps it uncached and read-only in the root VSpace, then performs only volatile reads of device_feature_select and device_feature.
validated_contract.teardown: The root unmaps with VSPACE_PRESERVE, frees the reservation and frees the root-owned VKA frame before return; no frame cap is copied outside root.
validated_contract.feature_window: Only the device's current selected 32-bit feature window is observed; M2 performs no selector write and therefore does not claim complete feature enumeration.

not_claimed: BAR or frame-cap delegation to a driver domain
feature selector write, accepted-feature write or FEATURES_OK
virtio status mutation, reset, ACKNOWLEDGE, DRIVER or DRIVER_OK
virtqueue creation, notification, interrupt acknowledgement or IRQ capability
DMA lease, IOMMU containment, descriptor buffers or block request
storage driver domain, writable filesystem, persistent storage, dpkg or apt
